group.label: Add-ons
group.comment: Show the newest Mago Assistant add-ons in the chat panel. The feed is a public JSON document at askmago.com, fetched once when an administrator first opens the panel and then cached for a week. The request carries nothing about the store beyond what any HTTP request carries: its server address and the user agent MagoAssistant-Mago. Off by default.

field.label: Show new add-ons
field.comment: Switching this off stops the section as well as the request to askmago.com; nothing is fetched until it is on.
